title: One editor: the Customizer moves into the app
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: Your Nyborg's look and builds are edited right in the Nyborg app now: hair style, colour and accessories on one side, a build tab for each arena on the other. The Tank Arena keeps its loadout triangle.
The old Customizer link takes you straight to your Nyborg's editor with nothing lost, and a new Backup screen downloads and imports your Nyborgs as files.
next: Saving a Nyborg from someone's match link.
